title: Python 3.14 Foundations: Automation & Data Scripts
concept: Start programming with Python 3.14 by automating real chores: strings and collections, functions, match/case, files, CSV and JSON, cleaning messy data, errors and a small reporting CLI.
description: A beginner course for people who can write a little code and want Python scripts that do real work without surprises. Every lesson starts from a small incident at an online shop - a revenue of 175000175000 because a price was still text, a restock list that puts every SKU on every shelf, a gift-wrap note that leaks into every packing slip, a chat bot that treats every command as a refund, a CSV export that turns Hà Nội into mojibake on Windows, a report that lists one city three times, an import job that swallows its errors, a log report that crashes at 2am - and fixes it with Python 3.14: strings and f-strings, lists, dicts and sets, functions, match/case, pathlib, CSV and JSON, Unicode normalization, exceptions and except*, dataclasses, type hints and argparse. 8 lessons with quizzes and Python coding challenges.

lessons.title: Functions & the mutable default argument bug
Cleaning messy data: normalize, dedupe, group
dataclasses, type hints & a log-report CLI
